about_the_game:
This is the official soundtrack for the game Tempopo. The music was composed and produced by Jeff van Dyck. The game was developed by Witch Beam and created by Sanatana Mishra and Seiji Tanaka.

The album is a whopping 91 tracks! There are "Think" tracks that play when you're thinking about the solution for a level. The "Action" tracks play when you press play in the game. "Success" plays when you solve the puzzle.

The tracks are in the order that you would hear them in game. The first half of the album has the instruments and vocals from the flowers, and the second half is the instrumental version.

The album features vocals by Angela van Dyck, Ella van Dyck and Enetes Turnbul.

Additional mixing by Matt McCamley.

Album art by Jessica Smith and Angus Coolan.
